verdict.rationale: Netlify documents serverless functions for building APIs, and a community user describes them as 'zero-config Lambda functions', which implies a standard Node-style serverless runtime rather than a restricted edge subset. However, nothing in the pack explicitly says unmodified Node.js code or arbitrary npm packages run in these functions, or what limits apply to edge functions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of full Node.js API compatibility, npm package support in functions and edge functions, runtime limitations, and hands-on corroboration.
